title: 2010 AMC 12A Problem 2
statement: A ferry boat shuttles tourists to an island every hour starting at \(10\) am until its last trip, which starts at \(3\) pm. One day the boat captain notes that on the \(10\) am trip there were \(100\) tourists on the ferry boat, and that on each successive trip, the number of tourists was \(1\) fewer than on the previous trip. How many tourists did the ferry take to the island that day?

solutions.text:
The ferry makes \(6\) trips: at \(10,\) \(11,\) \(12,\) \(1,\) \(2,\) and \(3.\)

The numbers of tourists are \(100,99,98,97,96,95,\) so the total is \[ \begin{gathered} 6\cdot100-(1+2+3+4+5) \\ =600-15 \\ =585. \end{gathered} \]

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Count how many trips run from \(10\) am through \(3\) pm
The trip counts are \(100,99,\ldots,95;\) add them
